description: This file defines a basic HTTP client class, SugarHttpClient, that performs HTTP POST requests via cURL for use within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for making REST calls and error handling.

classes.name: SugarHttpClient
classes.description: A minimal HTTP client class used for performing POST requests via cURL in the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: callRest
methods.description: Sends a POST request to a specified URL with provided arguments, handling errors related to cURL availability and execution.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Returns the last error code or message encountered during HTTP operations.
